patch.summary:
Thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.

Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge. Choose Ecwid only if your buying job matches “Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Bus” rather than Salesforce Commerce Cloud's shape. Choose Salesforce Commerce Cloud only if your buying job matches “Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; ” rather than Ecwid's shape. Workflow advantage: Ecwid leans checkout-conversion; Salesforce Commerce Cloud leans wholesale-b2b, catalog-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Same category, different company size — Both sit in ecommerce, but documented company-size audiences diverge.
- Positioning: Ecwid is Embeddable storefront you add to an existing site — Starter $5/mo, Venture $29 annual, Business $49, Unlimited $119 (post 2 Mar 2026 tiles);; Salesforce Commerce Cloud is Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent quote only; enterprise SaaS landscape, not an SMB Shopify subs.
- Company-size focus: Ecwid (solo, micro, small-business) vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Ecwid-leaning checkout-conversion vs Salesforce Commerce Cloud-leaning wholesale-b2b, catalog-management.
- Researched limits: Ecwid — Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; Salesforce Commerce Cloud — Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet.

Limitations — Ecwid: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products; POS / omnichannel is limited versus Lightspeed Retail or Square; Salesforce Commerce Cloud: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet; Implementation is a multi-month SI programme, not a weekend theme install.

Poor-fit cases: Ecwid is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Catalog, B2B, and checkout depth trail Shopify-class commerce OS products · Salesforce Commerce Cloud is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is opaque GMV-% — hard to compare without a Salesforce worksheet · Avoid Ecwid if you actually need Salesforce Commerce Cloud's motion (Salesforce B2C Commerce (ex-Demandware) — Growth/Plus/Premium are GMV-percent qu)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
